pages.name: QGD: 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.e3
pages.notes: Plan 3 ran a minority attack without the Carlsbad exchange; plan 4 routed ...Nbd7-f8-e6 through the f8-bishop to control e4. Rewrote both; 0-0 to O-O; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.e3 c6 5.Nbd2 Nbd7 6.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the d2-knight via f1 to e3, where White's pawn stands. Rewrote it; British spelling, including Semi-Slav Defence.

pages.name: QGD: Tarrasch without Nc3
pages.notes: Plans blockaded on d4 and pushed d5-d4 while White's pawn is on d4. Rewrote plans 1-2 (dxc5 first); overview now says when the pawn is isolated; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Tarrasch without Nc3: 5.g3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed an ambiguous Nd2-f1-e3; plan 3 pushed e3-e4 with the pawn on e2. Fixed both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Tarrasch without Nc3: 5.g3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Ne4 with the knight on g8 and used an open c-file that is White's. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Tarrasch without Nc3: 5.g3 Nc6 6.Bg2
pages.notes: Plans blockaded on d4 and pushed d5-d4 with White's pawn on d4; plan 3 proposed a minority attack; plan 4 put the bishop on b7. Rewrote all; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Tarrasch without Nc3: 5.g3 Nc6 6.Bg2 Nf6
pages.notes: Plans blockaded on d4 and pushed d5-d4 with White's pawn on d4; plan 3 played Rc1 through the c1-bishop. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Tarrasch without Nc3: 5.g3 Nc6 6.Bg2 Nf6 7.O-O
pages.notes: Plans blockaded on d4 and pushed d5-d4 with White's pawn on d4. Rewrote both plans; overview wording; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined
pages.notes: Plan 1 ran a minority attack before any Carlsbad exchange; plan 3 played ...Ne4 with no knight on f6 and offered ...Bb4 as a fix for the light-squared bishop. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Spielmann Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 played Rc1 through the c1-bishop; plan 4 proposed a minority attack without the structure. Rewrote both; British spelling, including King's Indian Defence.
